description: Receipt fixture scenarios for validating batch capture, quiet processing, enrichment, and issue-only alerts.

scenarios.expectedCaptureBehavior: single receipt upload should process quietly
scenarios.notes: Use a clear grocery receipt with a common retailer and legible totals.

scenarios.expectedCaptureBehavior: one image should split into multiple independent receipts
scenarios.notes: This is the core UX validation for one upload producing many receipts.

scenarios.expectedCaptureBehavior: pdf should preserve raw document metadata and process without extra confirmation
expectedInfoSignals: capture channel recorded as email or pdf
scenarios.notes: Use an email-forwarded or downloaded retailer receipt PDF.

scenarios.expectedCaptureBehavior: system should process quietly but raise a duplicate-risk alert on the second matching receipt
scenarios.notes: Use two fixtures with the same merchant, same date, and very similar total.

scenarios.expectedCaptureBehavior: durable goods should become thing candidates with returnability and warranty hints
scenarios.notes: Use a receipt for furniture, electronics, sports gear, or appliances.

scenarios.expectedCaptureBehavior: processing should still succeed, but user attention should be requested only if extraction confidence is genuinely weak
scenarios.notes: Use a low-light, skewed, cropped, or crumpled receipt image.
